blind.description: A miniature stylized tea service set arranged on an oval silver serving tray with handles at each end. On the tray are an ivory-and-gold teapot with lid, three teacups on saucers filled with red tea, a small milk pitcher, and a dish containing golden-brown pastries. Surfaces are clean, solid, and continuous with no floating, melted, or broken parts.
blind.from_above: An oval silver tray with side handles containing a central teapot with handle and spout, three circular cups of red tea on saucers, a creamer pitcher, and a small bowl of pastries, casting a slight shadow downward-left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/10 the height of the figure (roughly 6 to 8 inches tall), and about 1.5 to 2 feet wide across the tray handles.
